not_numeric.animate(): draws an animation of the network over time
not_numeric.plot_path_trajectories(): draws the prefix tree of journeys
not_numeric.as.data.frame.dynet_animation(): the frames of an animation: layout coordinates and drawing attributes
not_numeric.summary.dynet_animation(): describes the frames of an animation
not_numeric.as_dynet.default(): raises dynet_unsupported_class for any class without a method
not_numeric.add_nodes(): adds vertices and their attributes; the spell table is unchanged
not_numeric.update_nodes(): edits vertex attributes; the spell table is unchanged

not_yet.motifs(): no reference runs on the ci machine: raphtory (whose three-node motif census the package's taxonomy follows) and SNAP are not installed; the retained raphtory 0.17.0 censuses (local testthat-equivalence/fixtures/raphtory-motifs.R) are typed values without a generator-written provenance. Needs raphtory on the ci machine or an enumerator of 3-edge delta-temporal motifs mapped to Paranjape et al.'s classes.
not_yet.random_dynet(): a random generator whose draws come from the package's own stream; needs a distributional test of the generated networks against each model (binomial, Poisson, block, activation)
not_yet.randomise(): null models drawn from the package's own random stream (seed = replays it); there is no argument to supply the permutations, so no reference can share them
not_yet.significance(): its p-values come from randomise() draws on the package's own stream; needs an argument that supplies the null replicates
not_yet.temporal_communities(): a Louvain search whose moves are drawn from the package's own stream (seeds = replays it); GenLouvain and multinet's glouvain find their own optima, so only the quality of the result (checked through multislice_modularity()) can be compared
not_yet.as.data.frame.dynet_collapsed_list(): returned only by collapse_network(sessions = 'separate'); a sessioned test dataset with a per-session ledger is still to be written
